page_title: ARS 5-0 CHE | Arsenal v Chelsea 23/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Djordje Petrovic.
90+6' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+3' Declan Rice (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
90+1' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
88' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post.
88' Jorginho (Arsenal) is penalised for holding. Simon Hooper signals a set piece.
86' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
83' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bukayo Saka departs the field of play to be replaced by Fabio Vieira (Arsenal).
79' The game has come to an end for Noni Madueke. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Cesare Casadei (Chelsea).
78' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Thiago Silva (Chelsea) replaces Alfie Gilchrist.
78' Gabriel (Arsenal) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
76' Ben White (Arsenal) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
74' The attendance is 60238.
72' Substitution. Takehiro Tomiyasu makes his way off the pitch and Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) comes on as his replacement.
72' Substitution. Jorginho (Arsenal) has come on for Thomas Partey.
72' Substitution. Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Kai Havertz walks off.
72' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) replacing Leandro Trossard.
70' 5 - 0 What a hit! Ben White (Arsenal) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the top left corner. 5:0.
69' David Raya reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) towards the middle of the goal.
67' Substitution. Enzo Fernandez did his best and is replaced by Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea).
66' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to substitute Mykhailo Mudryk and he is replaced by Raheem Sterling (Chelsea).
65' 4 - 0 Bukayo Saka passes the ball into the penalty area. Kai Havertz (Arsenal) collects it and quickly sends it into the bottom right corner via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 4:0!
63' Arsenal keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
61' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Noni Madueke. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post.
60' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
60' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
57' 3 - 0 Goal! Martin Odegaard slips a clever pass through to Kai Havertz (Arsenal), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the roof of the net. 3:0.
56' Djordje Petrovic displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Kai Havertz (Arsenal) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
52' 2 - 0 Goal! Ben White (Arsenal) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
52' Declan Rice (Arsenal) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
51' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
49' A pass into the box finds Declan Rice (Arsenal) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Djordje Petrovic denies him.
47' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
47' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Thomas Partey (Arsenal). Simon Hooper saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Chelsea have a free kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Mikel Arteta is stunned as referee Simon Hooper shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
44' A pass from Noni Madueke (Chelsea) is intercepted by David Raya and the move breaks down.
43' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) picks up a yellow card.
42' Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
42' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Raya intercepts the ball.
38' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
37' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) plays a through ball but overhits it.
35' The cross into the penalty area from Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
34' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
34' Arsenal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
33' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
32' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
30' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the left post.
29' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
29' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:3.
27' Great chance! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.

27' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Djordje Petrovic leaps like a salmon to deny him.
26' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Djordje Petrovic makes a great save.
25' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
24' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

24' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.
24' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
22' Declan Rice (Arsenal) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
22' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
21' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Raya, who smothers the ball.
18' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
17' The ball is cleared after Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
16' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
16' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

15' Martin Odegaard plays a lofted pass into the six-yard box. Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) gets his head on the ball but balloons it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
15' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes it short.
14' The resulting corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared. Corner kick. Arsenal will have an opportunity.

14' Ben White (Arsenal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Arsenal.
12' Arsenal are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
10' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
10' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Simon Hooper who sees an offensive foul.
9' The game is interrupted now, Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
8' Ben White (Arsenal) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
8' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes a mid-range free kick and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
8' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) brings an opponent down and Simon Hooper interrupts the game. There is a free kick near the sideline to Arsenal.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Declan Rice plays a pass to the feet of Leandro Trossard (Arsenal), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:0.
2' Referee Simon Hooper sees the trip by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
1' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Chelsea will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Simon Hooper.
